sideConvention: izquierdo/derecho desde el personaje; izquierdo = derecha del espectador
registration: Ediciones de GPT Image registradas a coordenadas fijas sobre el lienzo de la base.
note: La base es referencia; no apilarla bajo cuerpo. Usar cuerpo como fondo para cambiar expresiones.

layers.name: cuerpo
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the joined body and head silhouette, without arms, feet, eyes, mouth or nose. Fully repaint the removed facial-feature areas with matching continuous fur; preserve cheek blush. Fully paint shoulder attachment regions with fur, no holes. This is the opaque underlying body layer.

layers.name: brazo-izquierdo
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's left arm (on the viewer RIGHT), including its pink five-finger paw. Preserve its exact position and angle. Include extra matching fur at its shoulder end for rotational overlap.

layers.name: brazo-derecho
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's right arm (on the viewer LEFT), including its pink five-finger paw. Preserve its exact position and angle. Include extra matching fur at its shoulder end for rotational overlap.

layers.name: pie-izquierdo
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's left pink foot (on viewer RIGHT), exactly at its original location. Include a small overlapping attachment area at the ankle.

layers.name: pie-derecho
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's right pink foot (on viewer LEFT), exactly at its original location. Include a small overlapping attachment area at the ankle.

layers.name: nariz
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the large pink pear-shaped nose including both nostrils, at exactly its original facial position and size. No fur backing or mouth.

layers.name: ojo-izquierdo-abierto
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's left shiny black bead eye with white highlight (viewer RIGHT), at its exact original position. No fur backing, skin patch, or other feature.

layers.name: ojo-derecho-abierto
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's right shiny black bead eye with white highlight (viewer LEFT), at its exact original position. No fur backing, skin patch, or other feature.

layers.name: ojo-izquierdo-feliz
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the LEFT eye slot on viewer RIGHT, replacing that eye with a happy closed upward arch curve. Same center and scale as the original eye. No fur backing or skin.

layers.name: ojo-derecho-feliz
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the RIGHT eye slot on viewer LEFT, replacing that eye with a happy closed upward arch curve. Same center and scale as the original eye. No fur backing or skin.

layers.name: ojo-izquierdo-somnoliento
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the LEFT eye slot on viewer RIGHT, replacing that eye with a half-closed sleepy eyelid and partially visible black eye. Same original eye center and scale. No fur backing.

layers.name: ojo-derecho-somnoliento
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the RIGHT eye slot on viewer LEFT, replacing that eye with a half-closed sleepy eyelid and partially visible black eye. Same original eye center and scale. No fur backing.

layers.name: ojo-izquierdo-sorpresa
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the LEFT eye slot on viewer RIGHT, replacing it with a wide surprised shiny black eye, slightly taller, centered at the original eye position. No fur backing.

layers.name: ojo-derecho-sorpresa
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the RIGHT eye slot on viewer LEFT, replacing it with a wide surprised shiny black eye, slightly taller, centered at the original eye position. No fur backing.

layers.name: boca-sonrisa
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the soft closed smile mouth at its exact original location and scale. No nose, fur backing, or eyes.

layers.name: boca-feliz
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a happy open smile mouth with pink inner rim and tongue, centered at the original mouth position, appropriate to the reference. No nose, fur backing, or other features.

layers.name: boca-sorpresa
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a small round surprised O mouth centered at the original mouth position. No nose, fur backing, or other features.

layers.name: boca-triste
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a small sad downturned mouth frown centered at the original mouth position. No nose, fur backing, or other features.

layers.name: boca-risa
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a wide open laughing mouth, pink inner rim and tongue, centered at the original mouth position. No nose, fur backing, or other features.

layers.name: boca-neutral
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a short flat neutral mouth line centered at the original mouth position. No nose, fur backing, or other features.

layers.name: mejilla-izquierda
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's left soft pink oval cheek blush (viewer RIGHT) in the exact original location, with softly feathered transparent edges. No brown fur backing.

layers.name: mejilla-derecha
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's right soft pink oval cheek blush (viewer LEFT) in the exact original location, with softly feathered transparent edges. No brown fur backing.

layers.name: gafas
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a new accessory layer: round fine gold eyeglasses perfectly positioned over the original two eye centers, bridge fitting over the original nose. No eyes or head; transparent lens interiors; no opaque lens fill.

layers.name: moneda
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a new accessory layer: a large shiny gold coin centered over the middle of the original character chest/belly, about 220 px in diameter in this 1024 px canvas. No arms, body, or hands. Painterly finish matching the reference.

layers.name: casco-minero
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a new accessory layer: a yellow miner helmet with its front lamp, fitted precisely on top of the original character head, with a slight overlap at the crown. No fur or face. Painterly finish matching the reference. Entire helmet remains inside canvas.

layers.name: ceja-izquierda
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a thin dark brown expressive eyebrow just above the original left eye (viewer RIGHT), neutral raised curve. No eye, fur backing, or other feature.

layers.name: ceja-derecha
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY a thin dark brown expressive eyebrow just above the original right eye (viewer LEFT), neutral raised curve. No eye, fur backing, or other feature.

layers.name: brazo-izquierdo-saludo
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's LEFT arm (viewer RIGHT) edited into a raised waving pose, pink five-finger palm visible. Keep the shoulder pivot in EXACTLY its original location, add overlap fur there; all other pixels transparent. Do not move or resize the canvas.

layers.name: brazo-derecho-saludo
layers.instruction: Keep ONLY the character's RIGHT arm (viewer LEFT) edited into a raised waving pose, pink five-finger palm visible. Keep the shoulder pivot in EXACTLY its original location, add overlap fur there; all other pixels transparent. Do not move or resize the canvas.
